answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity compute lease: an agent must burn scarce inference budget proving it ran a pinned model on a unique seed, and the relayer accepts one lease per hardware attestation. Credit earned, a small ember per lease, cannot be merged, so ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand real GPU-seconds and a fresh attestation chain each. An oasis of auditors samples outputs, and each identity posts a vault of collateral refundable only after a clean audit, forfeited on capture. Cost grows linearly with accounts while payoff per fake stays flat, so the economics die.
